changes.reason: Replace the pre-transaction mutex with a context-aware one-slot Queue admission gate. A queued cancellation returns before transaction entry without changing durable Queue state; continuing requests retain previous serialized owner checks and operation transitions.

models.limits: Abstract Fail and peer frame do not model Go channel selection, queue fairness, context timing, SQLite transactions, disconnection or any service-side timeout. The deterministic leaf regression addresses local waiting cancellation separately.
Normalized owner admission remains unchanged before the gate; no modeling of real authentication, context/channel admission or transport timing.

changes.reason: Test-only fixture holds one real SQLite transaction and verifies a second authenticated leaf call exits before release, leaves no row and permits retry. No additional consumer or runtime behavior.
